intent: REFACTOR TelemetryContracts: inspect the implementation for layering violations (domain free of framework/DTO types), blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and duplication; refactor while keeping the public API and tests green. Unit definition: Context: published language shared by Telemetry Intake, Chronology Reconciliation and Telemetry Record Ledger. Final non-instantiable holder class with nested public immutable types, the single producer of every cross-context type. Enums: MetricType {HEART_RATE, POWER, CADENCE, GROUND_CONTACT_TIME, RESPIRATION, SWIM_PACE}; ValidationStatus {VALID, VALIDATION_FAILED}; RevisionReason {ORIGINAL, CORRECTION, BACKFILL}. Records (all components non-null, NullPointerException otherwise): TelemetrySample(String deviceId, MetricType metricType, Instant tDevice, Instant tIngress, double value); TelemetrySampleValidated(TelemetrySample sample); TelemetrySampleValidationFailed(TelemetrySample sample, String reason); TelemetrySampleOrdered(TelemetrySample sample, ValidationStatus status); TelemetryBackfillDetected(TelemetrySample sample, ValidationStatus status, Duration lateness); TelemetryRecordAppended(String deviceId, MetricType metricType, Instant tDevice, int revision, RevisionReason reason); AppendFailed(String deviceId, MetricType metricType, Instant tDevice, String cause). tDevice is the authoritative ordering time; tIngress is never used for ordering. Pure value types, no methods beyond record accessors.
